title: A Practical LLM Pretraining Pipeline

items: One Lance table spans curation, tokenization, loading, and analysis
LanceDB engineering tutorial and public example code
A 124M model demonstration with explicit scaling limits

note: 这是 blog+code 工程示例，不是大规模 foundation model 训练的系统证明。

title: The table carries raw and derived state

items: Raw text remains available alongside curation flags and token IDs.
Derived columns capture new signals instead of exporting a separate corpus for every stage.
SQL predicates define selected training rows.

note: 统一表有利于 lineage，但不自动证明跨列 backfill 和训练读取是一致快照。需要显式 pin dataset version。

title: Example modules expose the lifecycle

items: ingest.py writes FineWeb-Edu or synthetic records into a Lance table.
curate.py computes curation signals and an exact-dedup flag.
tokenize_data.py and geneva_backfill.py populate token columns through local or distributed paths.

note: 模块路径均来自公开 example README。静态读取代码，不执行下载的数据管线。

title: Exact dedup has a precise semantic scope

items: The example collapses whitespace and computes an MD5 content hash.
Rows with the same normalized hash share an exact-match identity.
Embedding retrieval in later analysis does not turn curation into semantic deduplication.

note: normalized exact hash 可消除规范化后同文，但不会识别语义改写、跨语言重复或图片重复。

title: Backfill and training have different resource needs

items: Tokenization and embeddings can populate derived columns through checkpointed backfills.
Training consumes token columns after curation filters.
Separating enrichment from training prevents tokenizer or embedding work from repeatedly occupying the hot path.

note: 增量列计算是数据平面机制。任务恢复与训练恢复分别需要 state，不能混用一个 checkpoint 概念。

title: StreamingDataset shuffles and packs in the loader

items: The example uses lancedb.streaming.StreamingDataset.
Loader-side packing assembles token sequences without a mandatory offline packed-corpus export.
Read batch size, I/O queue depth, and transform parallelism control the CPU pipeline.

note: 需要同时统计有效 token、padding、CPU 时间及 HBM 输入等待。单看 rows/s 会掩盖序列长度变化。

title: Resume semantics constrain data partitioning

items: The README exposes num_splits and resume-auto options.
num_splits must divide the global batch and be divisible by world_size × num_workers when workers are enabled.
A stable table snapshot and loader state are needed to explain replay or omission across restarts.

note: README 的 world-size 约束不是任意 elastic training 保证。应注入失败测样本覆盖，而不是只看 loss 能继续下降。

title: Loader A/B controls use identical packed blocks

items: The example can export common packed blocks as Lance, Parquet, pre-shuffled Parquet, and MDS.
Common logical blocks reduce tokenization and packing confounders in loader comparisons.
CPU transforms and thread settings can dominate throughput.

note: 对比要固定 token 顺序、block 内容、存储位置与预取预算，不能拿不同数据准备方式的吞吐直接比较。

title: Evidence classification

rows: A control design to examine data loading
Search and attribution tools on the same table

note: 博客的演示耗时不能外推为大模型训练加速比。代码可见不代表本文已在对应硬件复现。

title: Scaling gaps remain measurable

items: One table does not eliminate object-store bandwidth, cache, or metadata bottlenecks.
Large distributed runs need evidence for sample coverage, recovery, and worker imbalance.
Model quality and total training cost require matched-token baselines beyond a 124M demo.

note: 工程选型需分离读吞吐、数据准备成本和最终训练质量。作者示例给出起点而非规模上界。

title: Architecture application proposal

items: Inference: a stable record key can connect selected data to post-training attribution.
Proposed application: pin table version, filter expression, tokenizer, and loader config in each run manifest.
Proposed application: keep expensive annotations reusable across independent experiments.

note: 不要在 deck 中写入真实业务或雇主数据。通用 run manifest 足以解释设计。

title: Reproduction without a large training job

items: Start with the documented synthetic corpus and byte tokenizer under an explicit budget.
Validate normalized-hash groups and count emitted tokens across resume boundaries.
Then compare loaders with identical blocks before scaling the model or GPU count.

note: 这些是下一步建议，本次未执行研究代码。实现入口为 lancedb/training 的 llm_pretraining example。
